annotations.title: Trie your ſelues.
annotations.text: ◦ The Heretikes argue herevpon, that euery man may know him ſelf certainely to be in grace: vvhere the Apoſtle ſpeaketh expreſly and onely of faith. the act whereof a man may know and feele to be in him ſelf, becauſe it is an act of vnderſtanding, though he can not be aſſured that he hath his ſinnes remitted, and that he is in al pointes in ſtate of grace and ſaluation: becauſe euery man that is of the Catholike faith, is not alwaies of good life agreable therevnto, nor the actes of our vvil ſo ſubiect to vnderſtanding, that vve can know certainely whether vve be good or euil. See S. Auguſtine to. 7 de perfect. iuſtitiæ c. 15. Li. de Cor. et grat. c. 13. & S. Thomas 1.2, q. 112. art. 5.

notes.text: We may know that we haue faith, but not that we are in grace.
